allOf.$comment: When kind is 'command' the finding MUST carry reproductionCommand (non-empty) and reproduced (boolean). reproductionCommand is what the orchestrator re-runs through the agent's Bash tool to decide whether to drop the finding.
When kind is 'inspection' the finding MUST carry evidencePointer (non-empty), the file:line + claim string a downstream auditor uses to confirm the defect actually exists in the cited code.

finding.description: One reviewer-authored defect claim. Discriminated on kind. The same id namespace is shared across both kinds; ids are slugs the proposer can also use as criterion keys downstream.

category.description: Short class name the reviewer used to group the finding (e.g. 'correctness', 'security', 'concurrency'). Free-form; the schema does not enumerate the set.

description.description: What the defect is, in one or two sentences. Non-empty so a finding with an empty description cannot pass validation.

evidencePointer.description: Inspection-kind only: a file:line plus the specific claim the downstream auditor checks. Required when kind is 'inspection'; forbidden as a sole signal when kind is 'command'.

file.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the file the finding concerns. No leading separator.

id.description: Stable slug identifying the finding within the bundle. ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore. Used as a join key when the finding is promoted to a criterion.

line.description: 1-based line number in the cited file at the tip of the run branch.

reproduced.description: Command-kind only: true if the reviewer ran the reproductionCommand and saw the failure, false if asserted without local execution. Required when kind is 'command'.

reproductionCommand.description: Command-kind only: a shell command the orchestrator runs from the worktree root to reproduce the defect. Required when kind is 'command'; ignored when kind is 'inspection'. The string is run verbatim under the orchestrator's H1-confined Bash; the schema refuses chaining/substitution/redirection/newline/NUL bytes (banned characters: ; & | backtick $ < > backslash newline carriage-return NUL) and caps length at 512 so a prompt-injected diff cannot steer the reviewer into authoring a destructive payload.

suggestedCriterion.description: A specific, testable restatement the proposer can adopt as a new contract criterion. Non-empty.

findingKind.description: Discriminator between a command-reproducible finding (carries reproductionCommand + reproduced) and an inspection finding (carries evidencePointer).

severity.description: Severity tier per the measurement-vs-gating convention. blocker triggers a renegotiation round if a corresponding criterion is missing; warning is surfaced and may trigger; advisory is measurement-only.

summary.description: Tallies the reviewer wrote when it emitted the bundle. blockers/warnings/advisories count findings of that severity; dropped is 0 in the reviewer's initial bundle and is incremented by the orchestrator's reproduction guard.

description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the artefact the independent-reviewer agent writes per sprint attempt. The bundle is the reviewer's findings list plus a per-severity tally; the orchestrator's reproduction guard later runs each command-kind finding's reproductionCommand and drops it if it does not reproduce, incrementing summary.dropped. additionalProperties is false at the top level and inside every nested object so a typo in a field name is caught at validation time rather than silently dropped.

attemptLetter.description: Uppercase ASCII letter naming the generator attempt within this sprint (A, B, C, ...).

contractRevision.description: Index of the locked criteria revision this review was authored against. 0 for the original lock; incremented each time a renegotiation round re-locks. The orchestrator supplies it as input and the reviewer copies it through verbatim.

findings.description: Ordered list of findings the reviewer surfaced. May be empty (a clean review). Each finding is independently actionable.

reviewerPromptDigest.description: Optional lowercase SHA-256 hex digest (64 characters) of the independent-reviewer prompt file content as installed under ~/.claude/agents/. Stamped by the orchestrator at reviewer spawn so two review bundles produced under different reviewer-prompt versions are distinguishable. Additive on v1 per the additive-stays-vN ruling in specifications/roadmap.md; consumers that omit the field continue to validate.

title: ClaudeAgents independent-review bundle, v1
